project.title: The simplest way to balance six denim shapes

cast.woman_identity: Original adult female fashion presenter, warm medium skin, shoulder-length dark auburn bob, deep brown eyes, consistent facial proportions and height. Use original locked character sheet.
cast.man_identity: Original adult male fashion presenter, medium tan skin, short dark hair, relaxed athletic build, deep brown eyes, consistent facial proportions and height. Use original locked character sheet.

studio.description: Same original editorial studio throughout: ivory pleated wall, narrow warm limestone wing, walnut sculpture plinth right, pale stone floor, diffuse natural softbox from left; straight-on full-body tripod shot with head-to-shoe framing.

scenes.title: Wide jeans and fitted top
scenes.woman_outfit: Mid-blue wide-leg jeans, close-fitting white cotton crew tee, narrow belt, minimal flats.
scenes.man_outfit: Mid-blue relaxed wide jeans, fitted cream polo shirt and minimal low-profile sneakers.
scenes.action: Woman points briefly toward the wider hem; man stays relaxed, hands near pockets.

scenes.title: Slim jeans and relaxed top
scenes.woman_outfit: Dark-indigo slim jeans, slightly oversized cream poplin shirt, brown shoulder bag, loafers.
scenes.man_outfit: Slim dark-indigo jeans with cream casual knit and suede loafers.
scenes.action: A subtle shirt-adjustment and a small natural weight shift.

scenes.title: Straight jeans and tailored layer
scenes.woman_outfit: Straight-cut medium blue jeans with tailored taupe waistcoat and low-heel shoes.
scenes.man_outfit: Straight-cut jeans, taupe fine-knit top, light relaxed blazer and brown loafers.
scenes.action: Both stand naturally, and the woman makes a tiny one-handed gesture.

scenes.title: Barrel jeans and clean top
scenes.woman_outfit: Soft barrel jeans with a close-fitting black tank top and minimalist leather handbag.
scenes.man_outfit: Tapered barrel-cut jeans in dark blue with clean black casual tee and low-profile loafers.
scenes.action: Natural posture and subtle breathing, no exaggerated motion.

scenes.title: Bootcut jeans and elegant blouse
scenes.woman_outfit: Deep-indigo bootcut jeans with elegant burgundy v-neck blouse, small structured bag and heeled shoes.
scenes.man_outfit: Dark bootcut-inspired straight jeans with a burgundy knit under a tailored dark layer.
scenes.action: Woman turns shoulders slightly toward the camera; man remains naturally still.

scenes.title: Light denim and soft neutral
scenes.woman_outfit: Light blue wide-leg jeans with a sage-green fitted knit, light leather bag and white shoes.
scenes.man_outfit: Light blue relaxed jeans with soft sage fine knit, pale sneakers and matching minimal belt.
scenes.action: Woman makes one relaxed explanatory gesture; man gives a small smile; maintain exact framing.
